references.text: Psalm 18:24 speaks of reward based on righteousness, which can be seen in light of the reward mentioned in Matthew 5:46.
John 13:34-35 commands us to love one another as Jesus has loved us, challenging the idea of only loving those who love us back.
Romans 5:7-8 shows God's love for us through Christ, even when we were sinners, as a contrast to merely loving those who love us.
James 2:1-13 discusses showing favoritism and challenges believers to love and serve without discrimination, echoing Matthew 5:46 on loving beyond those who love us.
Isaiah 58:6-7 calls for acts of love and justice that go beyond self-interest, paralleling the call to love without expecting repayment as in Matthew 5:46.
